execution_model: One deterministic workflow orchestrator dispatches typed jobs to workers. Workers do not free-chat with each other. State is account-scoped; publishing remains fail-closed.
migration_policy: Move one bounded responsibility at a time. A legacy layer is retired only after all needed code is owned by an agent/shared contract, callers are migrated, tests pass, and production evidence is recorded.

agents.name: Research Discovery Agent
agents.owns: Discover candidate topics, collect attributable web evidence, check the target account's known publication history, and persist an evidence pack for Agent 06. Does not verify claims, score, write content, or publish.
agents.output: JSON evidence-pack report with READY_FOR_VERIFICATION handoff to AG06; this is not a factual-verification result or publishing permission.
agents.gate: unit contracts, account isolation, durable Neon state, CI, and live production smoke

source_configuration.provider: Tavily Search API when TAVILY_API_KEY is configured; otherwise public GDELT Context API
source_configuration.fallback: Real keyless GDELT Context API; rate-limited and fails closed if it cannot return real article sentences from two independent hosts
source_configuration.query_budget: Tavily capped at five candidates; GDELT capped at three candidates, searches the supported 72-hour context window, and sends no more than one request every five seconds

production_blockers: A real provider smoke must return at least one eligible candidate with two independent publisher hosts per enabled account
The enabled account's history baseline must be imported and verified before every production recommendation
CI and live Neon-backed evidence must pass on the exact release commit
The authenticated deployed API path must dispatch the real agent and read back the report, candidate, and evidence from Neon
After the deployed API path passes in certification mode, set status to production_ready and rerun the gate in production dispatch mode
